item.title: About
item.description: The idea behind this site is to post the occasional tech “stuff” I encounter while working in Linux and my home lab. Hopefully the items I post will be educational to the occasional reader who may find my post beneficial to their tech life. I work in the Information Technology field as a Linux Systems Administrator contractor at NASA on the Artemis program. In the past I have worked with IBM and NetApp storage; Dell, HP, IBM, and Lenovo servers; Cisco and Ubiquiti networking; Windows, VMware ESXi, and various Linux operating systems.
